31512: An ex-CIA operative is thrown back into a dangerous world when a mysterious woman from his past resurfaces. Now exposed and targeted by a relentless killer and a rogue black ops program, he must rely on skills he thought he left behind in a high-stakes game of survival.
31768: In the late 1980s, Pat Tate journeys from peddling pills in Marbella to his time in prison, where he solidifies his power before his release to reclaim his turf.
32024: The teenage son of two fathers makes a documentary film about his parents but is surprised when a real-life plot twist occurs in his family.
A movie about a family like any other.

Two young girls... trapped... with no escape! Forced to submit to the Horrors of the Pit!

The true story of a family that fought Nazi madness with the only weapon they had. Love.

In the evening a party awaits them...
33304: Colonia Helena, Argentina. The mysterious Tomás Kóblic, a former Navy pilot, works as a fumigator while dealing with his dark past and the intrigues of the corrupt police commissioner…
There is nowhere to hide from yourself

IT FILLS THE SCREEN with Excitement and Suspense!
33816: When a deep space fishing vessel is robbed by a gang of pirates, the Captain makes a daring decision to go after a rare and nearly extinct species. His obsession propels them further into space as the crew spins toward mutiny and betrayal.
34072: Newly-weds Rehaan and Shaina move to Romania after the former is offered a job. When Shaina senses paranormal activity around her, she learns that her husband is harbouring a secret from her.
34328: Prabhu, a college student, falls in love with Shruthi, a governor's daughter. On knowing about their love affair, her father imprisons Prabhu and forbids him to meet Shruthi.

34840: A group of teenagers encounter vampires in a remote outpost.
Something to Sink Your Teeth Into.
35096: A black laborer turns preacher after accidentally killing a man.
35352: After her 27th birthday, Silvia Prieto decides to take charge of her life and make some changes. At the same time, she suddenly finds herself intertwined in the life of another woman who is also named Silvia Prieto.
A reflection on what it means - or does not mean - to be yourself.
35864: Mannu, an ambitious yet carefree guy who wants to stay away from this violence, gets entangled in the lives of gangsters as Durai, whom his brother Dhana wanted to protect, dies.
36120: Escaping from China with a microfilm of the formula for the mysterious "Lotus X", Lord Southmere, a Queen's Messenger, is chased by a group of Chinese spies.
36376: When things get tough for offbeat Carys Reitman, she does what any emotionally isolated, modern girl would do - she goes to strangers' funerals...
Meet Carys. She's a mourning person...

When a thunderstorm forces his party into a nearby mansion, Vince discovers that the bizarre room does exist, and it means nothing but trouble.
36888: Sebahattin is known around town as a magnet for misfortune. But to win over the woman of his dreams, he changes his ways to change his luck.

One night, drunk, William writes Octavius, demanding his daughter's hand; but, being drunk, he asks for the wrong sister.
A Fiery Girl Who Dares The Dangers Of The Sea And A Savage Land... Fighting For The Love Of A Bold Adventurer!
37400: Olivier, the nine-year-old son of Elisabeth and Serge, a country veterinarian, vanishes one afternoon on the way to his grandmother's house. The emotional aftermath of his disappearance sends his father packing and nearly destroys his mother.
Life is never as innocent as it seems.
37656: Fely is an elderly woman who finds second chance at youth after a visit to a mysterious photo studio.
37912: An American family visiting their Irish roots accidentally stumbles on a horde of bloodthirsty mutant children.
38168: Pippi Longstocking is an extraordinary little girl who lives alone in her house, while her father sails the seven seas. Pippi's irrepressibly fun nature makes her easy to befriend, as neighbors Tommy and Annika find, but can also earn ire, especially from social worker Mrs. Prysselius.
Her name is about all you can handle!
38424: Loot is the story for five guys who find quick ways of success and accomplishment in life. It is a quest for quick money and better life. Loot is the real picture of Kathmandu; the city of crime and lawlessness like never explored before.

38936: A simple minded peasant was recruited in the Egyptian army where he was deceived to believe that political activists are his homeland enemies, but not for so long.
39192: A five-year-old boy named Aravindan is abandoned by his mother at the Mookambika Temple. Afterwards, a local hotelier raises him, but he always hopes to meet his mother.

39704: Jin-hyeok opens a cake shop in an old antique shop, hiring Seon-woo, Korea's best pastry chef, who fell in love with him in high school. Also there, are Su-young, crushing on Seon-woo, ex-boxer Ki-beom, and Seon-woo's French ex-boyfriend.
39960: When 4 American tourists - Sofia, Carl, Belle and Michael - go on a ghost tour, they get much more than they bargained for, when the ghosts of an evil Doctor and his last patient victim trap them in the old abandoned psychiatric ward.

40728: Louise, an aimless, 28 year-old Brooklynite, recently single, sort of a musician, depressed without admitting to it, drunkenly falls while doing something stupid and breaks her hip. You’re never too old to come of age.

Moreover, Johannes falls in love with street artist Herta from Berlin. Written by emkarpf
41240: Three young guys got work from unlucky gangster... they try to make a great job but everything goes wrong
41496: Lisbon, 1938. Mr. Pereira is the editor of the culture section of an evening paper. Eventually, he's forced to take a stand...
41752: An unemployed man saves a rich woman and takes her to the hospital where her relatives mistake him as her husband. He plays along as he needs money to repay a loan.

The family priest warns Venable to tread carefully around her fantasies, but he wants the letters at any cost, even Tina's sanity.
42264: When Bruce Chatwin was dying of AIDS, his friend Werner Herzog made a final visit. As a parting gift, Chatwin gave him his rucksack.  Thirty years later, Herzog sets out on his own journey, inspired by Chatwin’s passion for the nomadic life, uncovering stories of lost tribes, wanderers and dreamers.
The world reveals itself to those who travel on foot
42520: A man is tasked with driving his embittered 80-year-old father-in-law cross country to be legally euthanized in Oregon, while along the way helping him rediscover a reason for living.
42776: Blaga is a seventy-year-old recently widowed former teacher and a woman of firm morals. When telephone scammers con her out of the money that she had saved for her husband’s grave, her moral compass slowly begins to lose its bearings…

43288: This time, the team we see with Ada is adapting to the conditions of an island while enjoying the sea and sun, setting sail for new adventures. While struggling to survive on the island where they will stay for a certain period of time, things start to get complicated with the addition of mysterious and even scary characters to the comical events they experience.
43544: An overworked nurse returns home to find a maniac hiding out with a bruised and beaten hostage. When an unexpected wave of violent intruders descend upon her home, it becomes a fight for survival.

They will have to rely on their wits and on each other in order to survive.
In the wilderness you can’t call 911.

There is something noble inside of you.

Official records have been destroyed, and the ministry that distributes benefits continues to deny her a pension. Twenty-six years after the war, she seeks out four survivors of her husband's garrison. Each tells a dramatically different story about her husband's conduct, but she is determined to learn the truth.
45080: A warm-hearted comedy about a compulsive soccer mom who masquerades as a famous Italian soccer star hired to coach her daughter's floundering soccer team, then struggles frantically to keep her wacky charade going long enough to see the girls win their big tournament.
45336: On a Japanese-occupied island during World War II, only two soldiers remain alive after a mission attempt goes horribly wrong. Is not just a war move.

A tale of tragedy that could only be as irreverent and sensational through the pen (or pencils, if you will) of Bill Plympton.
45848: After her grandparents are savagely attacked, Billie uses her knowledge of martial arts to begin dishing out her own brand of vigilante justice.
46104: A group of college students settle into what seems like an ordinary hostel, but things soon take a strange turn when a series of unexplained incidents begin to unfold. 46616: A seasoned FBI Agent's child-genius son assists him on catching a child-killer, a schizophrenic mohab nut who believes he's been chosen by god to be a new Noah.
A brutal slaying. An elusive killer. The chase is on.
46872: New Mexico Territory, August 1879. The few surviving members of a cavalry column, which has been relentlessly decimated by the Apaches, attempt to reach Fort Crain. On their way through a hostile land, the obsessive and ruthless Sergeant Vinson takes to the limit the battered will of the troopers under his command.
The West has never known a “Hero” like the Killer who commanded
47128: Using home videos from fans from across the globe and never-before-seen drone footage obtained during the victory parade in Buenos Aires, on streets dyed white and sky blue. The film invites viewers to immerse themselves in the world's most football obsessed nation, Argentina, to relive the emotional rollercoaster that was the country’s 2022 World Cup victory in Qatar and the record breaking celebrations that followed.
THE PEOPLE'S CUP. THE PEOPLE'S MOVIE.
47384: A brave prince must seek the fabled singing, ringing tree in order to win the heart of a beautiful princess.
The magical tale that haunted the dreams of a generation...

a story of love without bonds.
47896: Film adaptation of Anton Chekhov's story of life in rural Russia during the latter part of the 19th century.
The young are always young, foolish and totally out of step.
48152: The film, which focuses on the theme of brotherhood and the futility of war, tells the story of two enemy brothers facing each other on two separate fronts. 48408: Don Knotts is Hollis Figg, the dumbest bookkeeper in town. Runaway hilarity when Don Knotts runs down City Hall...in search of the buried secrets of a gang of crooked politicians. The movie the entire family will enjoy!
48664: Spanning over two decades, "For the Love of Money" follows the true account of an Israeli immigrant who searches for his piece of the American dream.
For the love of money is the root of all evil.

Since then, they fell in love and formed a couple that seemed perfect, until the moment they said “yes”. Without understanding what happened, now, every time this song plays, Marco will travel through his memories with Laura.
He just wants to hear her say yes.
49176: Michael is looking for a woman who likes to play games, but when he finds Suzanne, she might just be more than he bargained for.
He works hard, she plays harder.

49688: Two friends, Don and Dave were diving in the cave of Boesmansgat: 283 meters. Right before surfacing up, Dave - who'd just broken a world record - finds a body. They decide to dive back and retrieve it.

He meets Julissa and her dad who is not only fan but one of the team's managers. Andres and Julissa will fall in love and will have to pretend to be fan of the other's team. But soon trouble will arise.
When the eternal rivals fall in love

Cameo - The Man with the Dog

51224: 25-year-old Iiris and Karoliina have been best friends since childhood. Karoliina has been travelling and living abroad for some years now, but is coming back home for the summer as Karoliina has gotten them a job as waitresses in Hanko, the best summer city in Finland!
51480: A family gets lost in the Pine Barrens and becomes the prey of the Jersey Devil.
51736: A lawyer finds himself at the center of a trial in which a for-profit foster care agency puts a known sex offender into the same foster home as his young client Jamal, which leads to catastrophic results.
